text:
[LSTO.8.4.1] All async storage reads (`call storage.*`) use the
call / response correlation model (CALL_RESPONSE, pending
port). Cache is the exception in language semantics —
`cached("key")` is sync-intent and the read sits inside a
`let` rather than going through a response-fact pattern.
A sync-intent read completes in-rule: the engine answers
it from its in-memory cache per [LSTO.4.3.2] at RHS entry.
